meta.name: airdrop
meta.description: Send local files to nearby Apple devices through AirDrop with macOS guardrails, staging checks, and automation-friendly workflows.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 发送本地文件到附近的 Apple 设备
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要在 macOS 上通过 AirDrop 传输文件
copy.tagline_en: Send local files to nearby Apple devices via AirDrop
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to transfer files via AirDrop on macOS

howto.what: 装上后，当你要发送本地文件给附近的苹果设备时，Claude 会帮你暂存文件、让你确认要发送哪些内容，然后启动 macOS 的 AirDrop 分享界面来继续操作。
howto.when: 当你要求发送本地文件、截图、日志或报告等到附近的苹果设备，并且你的 Mac 已开启 AirDrop 时触发。

say.text: 把这份 PDF 隔空投送到我的 iPad。
say.note: Claude 会先确认文件，然后打开 AirDrop 界面。

say.text: 帮我截个图，然后隔空投送给旁边的 iPhone。
say.note: Claude 截图、暂存、然后启动 AirDrop。

say.text: 把这个文件夹压缩后隔空投送。

howto.what_en: When you want to send a local file to a nearby Apple device, Claude stages the file, asks you to confirm, then launches macOS's AirDrop picker so you can choose the recipient.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to send a local file, screenshot, log, or report to a nearby Apple device, and your Mac has AirDrop enabled.

say_en.text: AirDrop this PDF to my iPad.
say_en.note: Claude confirms the file, then opens the AirDrop chooser.

say_en.text: Take a screenshot and AirDrop it to my iPhone.
say_en.note: Claude captures, stages, and launches AirDrop.

say_en.text: Zip this folder and AirDrop it.
say_en.note: Claude zips first, then shares via AirDrop.
